{
  "name": "nit-band",
  "version": "0.1.1",
  "description": "Claude Code mod: learn to say your daily work in the language you want to work in. Your prompts, the way a teammate would say them, right above the prompt. Japanese → English by default.",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "author": {
    "name": "6igtree",
    "url": "https://github.com/6igtree"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/6igtree/nit-band",
  "repository": "https://github.com/6igtree/nit-band",
  "license": "MIT",
  "userConfig": {
    "speak": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language you work in",
      "description": "The language you usually write your prompts in.",
      "default": "Japanese",
      "options": [
        "English",
        "Japanese",
        "Chinese",
        "Korean",
        "Spanish",
        "French",
        "German",
        "Portuguese",
        "Vietnamese",
        "Hindi"
      ]
    },
    "learn": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language you are learning",
      "description": "Prompts in your working language are shown in this language, with one expression worth learning.",
      "default": "English",
      "options": [
        "English",
        "Japanese",
        "Chinese",
        "Korean",
        "Spanish",
        "French",
        "German",
        "Portuguese",
        "Vietnamese",
        "Hindi"
      ]
    }
  }
}
